# Orvio 0.22

- Browse movie and series genres with eighteen new images, search and multiple selections. The phone uses a bottom sheet; Android TV uses a side panel with visible remote-control focus.
- Genre filters stay within the current collection: Movies shows movie genres, Series shows series genres. Selection counts update before applying and work alongside your other filters.
- Improved IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes coverage by resolving missing release years and checking for available Rotten Tomatoes critic scores independently.
- Preserve more release-year and genre information from playlists. Titles without recognized genre data remain under Not specified.

Ratings are shown when a matching published score is available. Additional playlist metadata becomes available after a normal playlist refresh.
